mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from orders where status = 5 and pay_status = 1 and order_time between #{begin} and #{end}
select count(1) from orders where status = 5 and pay_status = 1 and order_time between #{begin} and #{end}
select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from orders where status = 5 and pay_status = 1 and merchant_id = #{merchantId}
select count(1) from orders where status = 5 and pay_status = 1 and merchant_id = #{merchantId}

select od.name, sum(od.number) as number from order_detail od join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = 5 and o.pay_status = 1 and o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} group by od.dish_id, od.name order by number desc limit 5

select od.name, sum(od.number) as number from order_detail od join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = 5 and o.pay_status = 1 and o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} group by od.dish_id, od.name order by number asc limit 5

select od.dish_id as dishId, od.name, sum(od.number) as number from order_detail od join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = 5 and o.pay_status = 1 group by od.dish_id, od.name order by number desc
